svg.aria-label: CJC-1295 without DAC versus with DAC. Two different molecules sold under one name
svg.text: CJC-1295 without DAC versus with DAC
Two different molecules sold under one name
CJC-1295 with DAC: 29-residue backbone plus albumin-binding linker (about 3,647 Da)
Longer-acting form; the added linker is the difference
CJC-1295 no DAC / Modified GRF 1-29: 29 residues (about 3,368 Da)
Shorter-acting form; often listed simply as CJC-1295
A mass of about 3,368 Da versus about 3,647 Da on the COA tells you which one you are looking at.
